newsitem.title: UK: Allied shares gain, adjusts pubs portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Allied shares gain, adjusts pubs portfolio.

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc rose 12p to 430p in brisk trading on Thursday with dealers attributing the rise to market players picking up cheap stock.
The stock's year low is 407p and today's low was 413p. Nearly four million shares changed hands.
"We've seen some bottom-fishing and that's about the whole story," said a dealer.
A report in the Independent newspaper said the group was expected to sell more than one hundred pubs to raise 12 million stg. Analysts said a deal that size would not move the share price.
Allied Domecq confirmed it was adjusting its portfolio.
"We are in the process of doing something. We are buying and selling all the time, improving the portfolio of our estate," said a spokeswomen.
She said more details would be available later today.
